description:
Kamizone is an innovative and dynamic fashion brand that combines modern design with premium quality, offering unique clothing and accessories for individuals who value both style and substance. We are committed to creating pieces that empower people to express their individuality while promoting sustainability and ethical practices. At Kamizone, we are passionate about redefining fashion with our contemporary, versatile collections, aiming to make a positive impact on both our customers and the environment.


Kamizone offers a curated collection of high-end, fashionable clothing and accessories for both men and women. From everyday essentials like shirts, jackets, and trousers to bold statement pieces, each item is crafted with precision and attention to detail. Our products are made using carefully selected materials that combine style with durability, ensuring a perfect balance between comfort and fashion. Kamizone is also dedicated to sustainability, offering eco-friendly products that are kind to both the planet and your wardrobe.

Kamizone stands out for its seamless blend of contemporary design with eco-conscious practices. Our unique selling point is offering fashion-forward clothing made from sustainable, high-quality materials, which allows customers to feel good about their purchases both in terms of style and ethical responsibility. With Kamizone, you can enjoy cutting-edge fashion that reflects your values and stands the test of time.


Kamizone provides flexible payment options to accommodate a variety of preferences. We accept major credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods. Additionally, we offer flexible payment plans to make shopping more accessible. All transactions are processed through secure encryption to ensure your information is kept safe.


At Kamizone, customer satisfaction is a top priority. We offer fast and reliable shipping to multiple countries, along with a simple and hassle-free returns process to ensure you are completely satisfied with your purchase. Our website is easy to navigate, making shopping convenient and enjoyable. As a forward-thinking brand, Kamizone is continually evolving, launching new collections, and keeping up with trends while maintaining our commitment to sustainability.

Affiliate Marketing Agreement

Kamizone.eu ("Merchant" or "Company"), a company incorporated under the laws of Denmark, with its principal place of business located at Østergade 15, 7470 Karup, and

Affiliate ("Affiliate")

The Merchant and Affiliate may collectively be referred to as the “Parties” or individually as a “Party.”

1. Purpose

The purpose of this Agreement is to set forth the terms and conditions under which the Affiliate will promote and market the Merchant’s products and services in exchange for commissions on sales made through the Affiliate’s efforts.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • The Affiliate agrees to promote the Merchant’s products/services through their website, social media accounts, email marketing, blogs, or any other agreed-upon marketing channels.
  • The Affiliate will use the marketing materials, links, banners, and any other resources provided by the Merchant in accordance with the guidelines and instructions.
  • The Affiliate shall not engage in any practices that might damage the reputation of the Merchant or violate any applicable laws or regulations.
  • The Affiliate must ensure that all promotional content is truthful, non-deceptive, and complies with all advertising regulations.

3. Merchant Responsibilities

  • The Merchant agrees to provide the Affiliate with tracking links, banners, product information, and other resources required to promote the products and services.
  • The Merchant will handle all customer service, order fulfillment, and product delivery issues.
  • The Merchant agrees to pay the Affiliate commissions on qualifying sales as described below.

4. Commission Structure

  • The Affiliate will earn a commission of X% of the sale price for each qualifying purchase made through the Affiliate's referral link.
  • Commissions will be paid monthly/quarterly, based on the sales generated during the previous period.
  • Payments will be made via (e.g., bank transfer, PayPal).
  • The minimum payout threshold is 200 Euro. If the Affiliate does not meet the threshold in a given period, the commission will roll over to the next period.
  • The Merchant reserves the right to change the commission structure at any time with prior notice to the Affiliate.

5. Tracking and Reporting

  • The Merchant will provide the Affiliate with access to a dashboard or reporting system where the Affiliate can track their sales, commissions, and performance metrics.
  • The Affiliate is responsible for ensuring that the tracking links are used correctly and that all relevant traffic is captured.

6. Affiliate's Relationship with Merchant

  • The Affiliate is an independent contractor and is not an employee, agent, or representative of the Merchant.
  • The Affiliate is solely responsible for all taxes, licenses, and other obligations related to their earnings under this Agreement.
  • The Affiliate has no authority to make any commitments or enter into any contracts on behalf of the Merchant.

7. Intellectual Property

  • The Merchant grants the Affiliate a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use its trademarks, logos, and other intellectual property solely for the purpose of this Agreement and in accordance with the Merchant’s guidelines.
  • The Affiliate agrees not to modify, alter, or misuse the Merchant’s intellectual property in any way.

8. Confidentiality

  • The Affiliate agrees to keep all proprietary information of the Merchant confidential, including but not limited to marketing strategies, sales data, and customer information.
  • This confidentiality obligation survives the termination of this Agreement.

9. Termination

  • Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice to the other Party.
  • Upon termination, the Affiliate will cease all promotional activities and remove any marketing materials related to the Merchant.
  • The Affiliate will be entitled to receive any outstanding commissions due up to the termination date, subject to the terms of this Agreement.

10. Indemnification

  • The Affiliate agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Merchant from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses (including legal fees) arising from the Affiliate’s breach of this Agreement or any other action related to the Affiliate’s marketing efforts.

11. Limitation of Liability

  • To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Merchant will not be liable to the Affiliate for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from this Agreement.
  • The Merchant’s liability will be limited to the amount of commissions earned by the Affiliate in the six (6) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

12. Governing Law

  • This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Denmark.
  • Any disputes arising under this Agreement shall be resolved in the courts located in Viborg , and the Parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts.

13. Miscellaneous

  • This Agreement represents the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, or negotiations, whether written or oral, concerning the subject matter hereof.
  • If any provision of this Agreement is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
